facts.text: Andrew enjoys watching birds in nature and reads books about ecological systems.

evidence.quote: Yeah! Like I said I do enjoy watching birds in the nature. I also read some books about our ecological systems as well.

facts.text: Andrew has learned about animals, plants, and ecosystems from reading books.

evidence.quote: I learned a lot about animals, plants, and ecosystems. It's fascinating to see how it all works together.

facts.text: Andrew plans to bring binoculars and a notebook to log birds during a trip.

evidence.quote: I'll bring my binos and a notebook to log them at the trip.

facts.text: Andrew believes that nature is connected and humans need to take care of it.

evidence.quote: Nature is all connected. We as human being need look after it.
